lydian_t1.subject: THE LYDIAN
lydian_t1.issues: Helmet came out closed (Chalcidian with nose guard): face half hidden; naturalistic heraldic lion on a cream field (not archaic, not crimson); bare sword blade; cartoon dog-bone knucklebone.

lydian_t2.subject: THE LYDIAN
lydian_t2.issues: Fixed helmet (Corinthian pushed up, face visible), archaic black-figure lion on crimson, sheathed sword. Knucklebone still a cartoon dog-bone: superseded by lydian_e1 (edit of this take).

lydian_e1_t1.subject: THE LYDIAN
lydian_e1_t1.issues: Edit of lydian_t2: real-looking lumpy astragalus in the palm inset and on the neck cord. Minor: the astragalus is a plausible knucklebone, not an anatomically exact sheep astragalus; scale corselet reads all-bronze rather than linen faced with scales; the lion is black-figure black on crimson (the brief said gold-ochre; black-figure is the more period-correct choice).

mede_t1.subject: THE MEDE
mede_t1.issues: Strong face and costume, but the akinakes hangs at the left hip, modern loafer-like shoes, reads 40+ with heavy grey.

mede_t2.subject: THE MEDE
mede_t2.issues: Curls at the nape, toy-horse inset excellent; but SHORT sleeves (brief: long-sleeved), modern lace-up boots, akinakes on the left in front/back views.

mede_e1_t1.subject: THE MEDE
mede_e1_t1.issues: Edit of mede_t2: long sleeves and soft thong-tied boots fixed; akinakes still on the left hip in front and back views.

mede_e2_t1.subject: THE MEDE
mede_e2_t1.issues: Edit of mede_e1: akinakes now on the right thigh in the 3/4 and profile views only; front and back still wrong.

mede_e3_t1.subject: THE MEDE
mede_e3_t1.issues: Edit of mede_e2 with per-view image-space instructions: akinakes on the RIGHT thigh in all four views, long sleeves, soft boots, toy-horse inset. Third-generation edit: very slightly more contrasty than t2, no visible artefacts.

mede_g1_t1.subject: THE MEDE
mede_g1_t1.issues: gpt-image-2 edit of mede_e2 with the same instruction: also correct in front/3-4/back, sword missing in profile, softer detail than NBP. Proof that gpt-image-2 follows left/right instructions better.

lyd_cav_rider_t1.subject: LYDIAN CAVALRYMAN
lyd_cav_rider_t1.issues: Open-faced crested bronze helmet (face clear), crimson chiton, bronze-scale linen corselet, ochre cloak, 3 m spear. Minor: lace-up boots look a little modern; cloak pinned at the front rather than the right shoulder.

lyd_cav_horse_t1.subject: LYDIAN CAVALRYMAN
lyd_cav_horse_t1.issues: Mounted sheet using the rider sheet as identity ref: same face/kit; chestnut stallion, crimson-and-ochre saddlecloth with girth and breast-strap, bronze-bossed bridle and frontlet, NO stirrups, unshod. Horse anatomy correct in all three views.

med_archer_t1.subject: MEDIAN ARCHER
med_archer_t1.issues: Hood reads as a medieval monk's cowl with shoulder cape; gorytos on his right hip and a bare blade on the left (both sides reversed).

med_archer2_t1.subject: MEDIAN ARCHER
med_archer2_t1.issues: Better bashlyk with lappets, but passing take 1 as reference copied its reversed gorytos/sword sides.

med_archer3_t1.subject: MEDIAN ARCHER
med_archer3_t1.issues: Good bashlyk with long lappets, sheepskin cloak, Scythian bow; gorytos and sword on reversed sides (model bias, every model). Source of the canonical mirror med_archer3_m.

med_archer3_e1_t1.subject: MEDIAN ARCHER
med_archer3_e1_t1.issues: NBP edit to swap sides: no change.

thales_t1.subject: THALES
thales_t1.issues: Excellent man and costume, but printed '(1) (2) (3) (4)' labels under the figures (text violation) and scribbles on the tablet.

thales_e1_t1.subject: THALES
thales_e1_t1.issues: Edit of thales_t1: printed view numbers removed. A superb, specific face, but he reads late 40s with grey temples, and the brief's point is 'about 40, not the old sage' (caption #16). Superseded by thales2_e1.

alyattes_t1.subject: ALYATTES
alyattes_t1.issues: Court/oath dress: gold fillet, long grey-streaked crimped tresses, murex-purple mantle with meander+rosette borders, white chiton, decorated red-brown boots, gold-knobbed staff, lion-head bracelets, phiale with boss in the inset. Minor: beard is a natural full beard rather than combed archaic locks.

cyaxares_t1.subject: CYAXARES
cyaxares_t1.issues: Superb torque with lion heads and winged-creature embroidery; but SHORT sleeves and akinakes on the left.

cyaxares_e1_t1.subject: CYAXARES
cyaxares_e1_t1.issues: Edit added long sleeves but deleted the kandys in the front and back views; sword still on the left.

cyaxares2_t1.subject: CYAXARES
cyaxares2_t1.issues: Long sleeves with embroidered cuffs, kandys as a cape, gold-plaque belt, roll of curls at the nape, lion torque; akinakes on the left thigh in every view. Source of the canonical mirror cyaxares2_m.

cyaxares2_e1_t1.subject: CYAXARES
cyaxares2_e1_t1.issues: NBP edit deleted the bow and gave him a long bare medieval-looking blade.

aryenis_t1.subject: ARYENIS
aryenis_t1.issues: Saffron crinkled chiton, crimson-purple mantle with animal-frieze borders and gold appliques, embroidered mitra with gold rosettes, fringe of small curls, stacked gold necklaces with pendants, granulated disc earrings, lion bracelets, striped lydion. Veil falls from the headband behind and beside the face, face fully uncovered. Minor: shoes read like modern flats.

astyages_t1.subject: ASTYAGES
astyages_t1.issues: Beanie-like cap, kandys worn as a short-sleeved coat, akinakes on the left.

astyages2_t1.subject: ASTYAGES
astyages2_t1.issues: Median cap with cheek flaps, madder long-sleeved tunic, kandys as a cape, torque, gold belt; family resemblance to cyaxares2; trousers read as black jeans; akinakes on the left.

astyages2_e1_t1.subject: ASTYAGES
astyages2_e1_t1.issues: Trousers fixed to red-brown wool; akinakes still on the left in every view. Source of the canonical mirror astyages2_m.

labynetus_t1.subject: LABYNETUS (mediator)
labynetus_t1.issues: Good Babylonian envoy, but the crescent pin was tilted like a modern Islamic crescent (wrong iconography, sensitive).

labynetus_e1_t1.subject: LABYNETUS (mediator)
labynetus_e1_t1.issues: Edit: Sin crescent lying on its back (horns up) on a gold disc. White robe with spiral fringed shawl (saffron/red fringes), curled beard, cylinder seal, staff, cuneiform-style tablet (signs are generic, not readable cuneiform). Minor: the cap reads a little like a modern skullcap.

syennesis_t1.subject: SYENNESIS (mediator)
syennesis_t1.issues: Patterned robe and upturned shoes good; bow-tie-shaped brooch (not a fibula), flat peaked cap, light flare at top.

syennesis_e1_t1.subject: SYENNESIS (mediator)
syennesis_e1_t1.issues: Edit: real arched Phrygian fibula, rounded felt cap with gold band, flare removed. Robe of red/ochre squares and rosettes, fringed shawl, upturned shoes, staff.

halys_wide_t1.subject: HALYS_WIDE
halys_wide_t1.issues: Beautiful light, but both armies stand on the SAME (near) bank, columnar poplars, sun not over the river's vanishing point.

halys_wide2_t1.subject: HALYS_WIDE
halys_wide2_t1.issues: Correct mirrored layout, but flat front light with the sun in frame, cloned parade ranks, Median caps read as fezzes. Used as the layout reference for frames F2 and F4.

halys_shallows_t1.subject: HALYS_SHALLOWS
halys_shallows_t1.issues: Good water/stones/tamarisk but a clear BLUE sky (breaks the no-blue Act I palette).

halys_shallows_b_t1.subject: HALYS_SHALLOWS
halys_shallows_b_t1.issues: Reverse angle into the low sun: red-brown water glittering over a gravel bar, tamarisk and reeds in silhouette, red-clay cut bank, poppies, wormwood, feather grass, warm sky. Reads as a side channel (narrower than the main river), which suits a duel ground.

halys_shallows2_t1.subject: HALYS_SHALLOWS
halys_shallows2_t1.issues: Side-lit variant (Caravaggio beam from the left), warm sky; but the beam is a visible god-ray shaft (cliche).

room_a_t1.subject: ROOM
room_a_t1.issues: Great layout (behind the low chair, RARE EARTH and circle, Earthset on the ultrawide, Sutro Tower in fog, Yagi, saros gear); but headphones ON her head with garbled brand-like lettering, red/cyan 3D glasses instead of eclipse glasses, an OS taskbar on the vertical monitor.

room_a_e1_t1.subject: ROOM
room_a_e1_t1.issues: Edit fixed headphones (around the neck), eclipse glasses (black filters), removed the taskbar; but garbled the '1420.405 MHz' sticker and the ECLIPSE MAP label.

room_a_e1p_t1.subject: ROOM
room_a_e1p_t1.issues: Angle A (behind the chair). Local composite: room_a_e1 with the sticker and poster label pasted back from room_a_t1 (aligned by phase correlation). Remaining: monitor/poster micro-text is pseudo-text (renderer replaces all screen content).

room_b_t1.subject: ROOM
room_b_t1.issues: Angle B: correct outfit, patch, headphones round the neck; but red/cyan 3D glasses.

room_b_e1_t1.subject: ROOM
room_b_e1_t1.issues: Edit fixed the glasses; garbled the sticker to '1420.40B'.

room_b_e1p_t1.subject: ROOM
room_b_e1p_t1.issues: Angle B (three-quarter front). Local composite: room_b_e1 with the correct '1420.405 MHz' sticker pasted back from room_b_t1.

room_c_t1.subject: ROOM
room_c_t1.issues: Close-up, good cel style and two-colour light; but grey eyes (sheet: dark brown), pale patch on the cheek, jacket read as a striped sweater.

room_c_e1_t1.subject: ROOM
room_c_e1_t1.issues: Angle C (face lit by the monitor): brown eyes, clean cheek, white bomber with one orange stripe; pearl monitor key + orange lamp rim; no yellow cast.

med_archer3_g1_t1.subject: MEDIAN ARCHER
med_archer3_g1_t1.issues: gpt-image-2 edit to swap gorytos/sword sides: front view unchanged, other views muddled.

med_archer3_m_t1.subject: MEDIAN ARCHER
med_archer3_m_t1.issues: Horizontal mirror of med_archer3_t1 (no generation): gorytos now at the LEFT hip and akinakes on the RIGHT thigh in all four views. Side effect: bow in the right hand; close-ups on the left and view order reversed. Minor: no corselet (optional in the brief); a little young-looking hood fabric.

cyaxares2_g1_t1.subject: CYAXARES
cyaxares2_g1_t1.issues: gpt-image-2 edit: sword moved to the right thigh in front and back views but deleted from the 3/4 and profile views; slightly softer detail.

cyaxares2_m_t1.subject: CYAXARES
cyaxares2_m_t1.issues: Horizontal mirror of cyaxares2_t1 (no generation): akinakes on the RIGHT thigh in every view. Side effect: the strung bow is now in his right hand, beside the sword; close-ups on the left. Long sleeves, kandys worn as a cape, roll of curls at the nape, grey curled beard, lion-head torque, winged-creature embroidery, gold-plaque belt. Minor: the madder cap is a little tall and close-fitting.

astyages2_g1_t1.subject: ASTYAGES
astyages2_g1_t1.issues: gpt-image-2 edit added a second scabbard instead of moving the first (two swords in the front view).

astyages2_m_t1.subject: ASTYAGES
astyages2_m_t1.issues: Horizontal mirror of astyages2_e1_t1 (no generation): akinakes in its gold-mounted scabbard on the RIGHT thigh in every view. Saffron Median cap with gold fillet and cheek flaps, madder long-sleeved tunic, ochre kandys as a cape, lion torque, red-brown trousers; warm, open face with his father's nose. Side effect: bow in the right hand.

thales_e2_t1.subject: THALES
thales_e2_t1.issues: NBP age-down edit of thales_e1: almost no change (NBP resists identity-level edits).

thales2_t1.subject: THALES
thales2_t1.issues: Fresh take at 38-40 with dark hair: right age, but loose centre-parted hair + headband + staff read as a stock Jesus image (meme risk); plain short sleeves.

thales2_e1_t1.subject: THALES
thales2_e1_t1.issues: NBP edit of thales2_t1: hair knotted at the nape under a braided fillet, upper lip SHAVED with a short pointed chin beard (archaic Ionian fashion), bronze pins along the sleeves. About 40, lean, sun-tanned, dry knowing half-smile, natural skin. Gnomon staff, wax diptych, bronze bowl of water, knotted cord, counting pebbles. Minor: one tally row on the tablet has a couple of pseudo-glyphs; himation is a single plain terracotta (no woven border).

thales2_g1_t1.subject: THALES
thales2_g1_t1.issues: gpt-image-2 version of the same edit: also good (knot, pins), softer photographic detail than the NBP edit.

med_cav_rider_t1.subject: MEDIAN CAVALRYMAN
med_cav_rider_t1.issues: Optional extra for equal dignity (mirror of the Lydian rider): madder bashlyk wrapped at the chin, kandys tied on by its sleeves, bronze scale corselet, two javelins; akinakes on the left, a pouch instead of the gorytos, reads ~45 not 30, lace-up boots. Source of the mirror med_cav_rider_m.

med_cav_rider_m_t1.subject: MEDIAN CAVALRYMAN
med_cav_rider_m_t1.issues: Horizontal mirror of med_cav_rider_t1 (no generation): akinakes on the RIGHT thigh. Known gaps: no gorytos (a pouch sits at the left hip), older than the brief's 30, boots read a little modern.

med_cav_horse_t1.subject: MEDIAN CAVALRYMAN
med_cav_horse_t1.issues: Nisaean-type bay with forelock topknot, cropped upright mane, knotted tail, bronze bit with horse-shaped cheekpieces, patterned saddlecloth + breast-strap, no stirrups, unshod. But the rider is barefoot.

med_cav_horse_e1_t1.subject: MEDIAN CAVALRYMAN
med_cav_horse_e1_t1.issues: NBP edit to give the rider boots also put leather boots on the horse's hooves.

med_cav_horse_g1_t1.subject: MEDIAN CAVALRYMAN
med_cav_horse_g1_t1.issues: gpt-image-2 edit: boots on the rider only, hooves bare, tack intact; akinakes on the rider's left. Source of the mirror med_cav_horse_m.

med_cav_horse_m_t1.subject: MEDIAN CAVALRYMAN
med_cav_horse_m_t1.issues: Horizontal mirror of med_cav_horse_g1_t1 (no generation): rider's akinakes on the right; topknot, upright mane, knotted tail, horse-cheekpiece bit, saddlecloth, no stirrups. Horse is leggier than the 'big, powerful' Nisaean of the brief.

halys_wide3_nbp_t1.subject: HALYS_WIDE
halys_wide3_nbp_t1.issues: Backlit, golden dust, long shadows toward camera, crimson lion shields and Median caps/wicker shields per the sheets, archers, both standards, sun over the vanishing point. But the river is a narrow straight canal, a little blue in the upper-right sky. Layout reference for halys_totality2.

halys_wide3_sdr_t1.subject: HALYS_WIDE
halys_wide3_sdr_t1.issues: Most naturalistic landscape (badlands, salt crust on the red-clay banks, tamarisk in bloom, feather grass, poppies), but pencil-thin columnar poplars (brief says avoid), meandering river breaks the perspective line, smaller armies.

halys_wide3_gpt_t1.subject: HALYS_WIDE
halys_wide3_gpt_t1.issues: The master composition: camera over mid-river looking downstream; broad red-brown river with gravel bars and side channels running straight to the low sun at the vanishing point; Lydians (crested helmets, crimson shields with black lions, cavalry, gold lion standard) left, Medes (madder caps, saffron, wicker shields, archers, cavalry, bronze horse standard) right; backlit with long shadows toward camera, glowing dust, broad-crowned trees only, red badland hills, poppies, warm sky with no blue. Minor: ranks are still parade-neat; river may be narrower than the real 100 m.

halys_totality2_nbp_t1.subject: HALYS_TOTALITY
halys_totality2_nbp_t1.issues: Black sun + warm corona + eclipse reflected in the river are good, but Jupiter is level-left of the sun, the horizon glow is brightest under the sun (should be darker there), and the armies are still day-lit and not looking up.

halys_totality2_gpt_t1.subject: HALYS_TOTALITY
halys_totality2_gpt_t1.issues: Matched to halys_wide3_nbp: silhouettes with orange rims, 360-degree glow brightest at both frame edges, warm small corona with two prominences. Jupiter too far left.

halys_totality2_gpt_j_t1.subject: HALYS_TOTALITY
halys_totality2_gpt_j_t1.issues: Local composite of halys_totality2_gpt: Jupiter moved to 11 deg above / 5.5 deg left of the sun on the frame's own angular scale. Paired with the narrower-river wide (halys_wide3_nbp).

halys_totality3_gpt_t1.subject: HALYS_TOTALITY
halys_totality3_gpt_t1.issues: Matched to the canonical wide (same river, gravel bars, hills): near-black umber sky, horizon glow brightest at the frame edges and darker under the black sun, silhouetted men looking up and pointing, corona-light path on the river. Jupiter in the wrong direction (mostly left).

halys_totality3_gpt_j_t1.subject: HALYS_TOTALITY
halys_totality3_gpt_j_t1.issues: Local composite of halys_totality3_gpt (no generation): reframed as a 4.8 deg tilt-up (top band = mirrored star-filtered sky, bottom 120 px cropped) because Jupiter's true position fell just above the frame at this 24 mm-equivalent scale; Jupiter then placed exactly 11 deg above and 5.5 deg left of the black sun (2.26x / 0.655x the sun's 8.4 deg altitude). Minor: corona streamers a little spiky; the armies are too dark to read costume (correct for deep twilight).

f1_eye_nbp_t1.subject: F1 THE EYE
f1_eye_nbp_t1.issues: Reads instantly as an eye AND an eclipse: black pupil, iris of pearly fibres with crypts and a darker limbal ring, a broken ring of pink prominences, corona wings beyond; ~55% of frame height; dark Altdorfer-ish battlefield on a red river below. Minor: the iris is a little too literal/photographic (could tip into kitsch); greyish iris tint.

f1_eye_gpt_t1.subject: F1 THE EYE
f1_eye_gpt_t1.issues: More painterly and subtler (corona as fur-like iris without a hard edge), better Altdorfer armies; but two small banners/flags (brief: none) and reads less instantly as an eye.

f1_eye_sdr_t1.subject: F1 THE EYE
f1_eye_sdr_t1.issues: Iris too large, white and flat; small pupil; reads as a cartoon eyeball more than an eclipse.

f2_bronze_nbp_t1.subject: F2 BRONZE
f2_bronze_nbp_t1.issues: Good cartouche ('THE RIVER HALYS', tasselled) and vortex sky, but the eclipsed sun sits on the hills left of the river's vanishing point and the figures look like toy soldiers.

f2_bronze_gpt_t1.subject: F2 BRONZE
f2_bronze_gpt_t1.issues: Altdorfer vortex sky in burnt gold/vermilion around a partially eclipsed sun exactly over the river's vanishing point (bright edge at the upper left, per RESEARCH 5.1), tasselled hanging tablet lettered THE RIVER HALYS cleanly, forests of glinting spears, mirrored armies with lion and horse standards, tenebrist land. Minor: Lydian shields show lion faces rather than archaic lions; curved horizon only slight.

f2_bronze_sdr_t1.subject: F2 BRONZE
f2_bronze_sdr_t1.issues: Striking tunnel-vortex sky and clean two-line cartouche; the vortex reads more sci-fi wormhole than Altdorfer, figures larger and stiffer.

f3_duel_nbp_t1.subject: F3 BRONZE CLOSE
f3_duel_nbp_t1.issues: Dramatic beam, both looking up, knucklebone visible on the Lydian's chest; more digital-illustration than oil, the Mede is seen from behind.

f3_duel_gpt_t1.subject: F3 BRONZE CLOSE
f3_duel_gpt_t1.issues: Muddy and near-monochrome, spears parallel, only one man looking up, faces grim: loses the story beat.

f3_duel_sdr_t1.subject: F3 BRONZE CLOSE
f3_duel_sdr_t1.issues: The duel in the red shallows stopped mid-strike: both men look up into one raking beam from the upper left, spears crossed overhead, water splashing; Lydian with braids, bronze helmet, scale corselet and black-lion shield, Mede with madder cap, curled beard, saffron long sleeves, iron scales and wicker shield; equal light and dignity; near-black umber surround, oil-paint handling. Minor: impasto moderate rather than thick; the beam is a visible shaft.

f4_corona_nbp_t1.subject: F4 CORONA
f4_corona_nbp_t1.issues: Crisp, minimal and elegant (orange river edges, contour-line terrain, real Median caps), but the black sun sits half-set on the horizon (should be 8 deg up).

f4_corona_gpt_t1.subject: F4 CORONA
f4_corona_gpt_t1.issues: Best field-line language, sun correctly above the horizon, but BOTH banks are Lydians (Medes missing). Fixed in f4_corona_gpt_e1.

f4_corona_gpt_e1_t1.subject: F4 CORONA
f4_corona_gpt_e1_t1.issues: gpt-image-2 edit: right bank redrawn as Medes (rounded caps, basket-weave wicker shields, archers with curved bows). Corona as dipole field-line loops in pearl, orange river edges and crests, navy-black ground, crisp thin lines, restrained glow, no violet, no particles. Minor: one crested rider remains near the right standard; the field-line corona is stylised far larger than the real one.

f4_corona_flx_t1.subject: F4 CORONA
f4_corona_flx_t1.issues: Armies are a noisy white sketch with orange fire-like edges; radial-line corona reads as a diagram.

f5_marble_nbp_t1.subject: F5 MARBLE
f5_marble_nbp_t1.issues: All elements present (statues, Thales in colour, frozen birds/arrows/spray, black sun, glow) but a BLUE night sky and river, two light dots instead of one Jupiter, a bare-chested Lydian statue.

f5_marble_nbp_e1_t1.subject: F5 MARBLE
f5_marble_nbp_e1_t1.issues: Edit of f5_marble_nbp_t1: umber sky with no blue, scale corselet on the Lydian statue, a single Jupiter. Still the superseded older Thales design.

f5_marble_gpt_t1.subject: F5 MARBLE
f5_marble_gpt_t1.issues: Statues are brown sandstone, not white marble; dense, muddy.

f5_marble_sdr_t1.subject: F5 MARBLE
f5_marble_sdr_t1.issues: White marble and photographic night, but Thales grins broadly and looks 50+; two sky dots.

f6_gold_nbp_t1.subject: F6 GOLD
f6_gold_nbp_t1.issues: Luminous, swords arcing, embraces, crescent sun returning; storybook-illustration faces (same laughing face repeated).

f6_gold_gpt_t1.subject: F6 GOLD
f6_gold_gpt_t1.issues: Rich Rubens-like paint, a Lydian and a Mede embracing, blades raining into a molten river; darker and busier, swords read as falling from the sky.

f6_gold_sdr_t1.subject: F6 GOLD
f6_gold_sdr_t1.issues: Tiepolo sky of rose, apricot and cream; warm low sun breaking out as a crescent at the end of the river; swords and spears thrown in arcs into the red water; a Lydian and a Mede embracing at the centre-left; joy on both banks; painted glow with no flare or god rays. Minor: the returning crescent's horns point the wrong way (should open up-left); slight cool tint at the top of the sky.

f7_orbit_nbp_t1.subject: F7 ORBIT
f7_orbit_nbp_t1.issues: Earth floats above the lunar horizon with a gap instead of setting behind it.

f7_orbit_gpt_t1.subject: F7 ORBIT
f7_orbit_gpt_t1.issues: Earthset: a blue Earth drawn in fine flowing contour lines with white cloud streamlines and cyclones, its lower part hidden behind a grey lunar limb drawn as dense topographic contour lines; one thin orange atmosphere line; black space, few stars. Blue only in the Earth. Minor: no night side/terminator; Earth is more rendered than pure line.

f7_orbit_flx_t1.subject: F7 ORBIT
f7_orbit_flx_t1.issues: Earth correctly setting behind the limb, but the orange line traces the Moon's limb (should be Earth's atmosphere) and the Earth is half photo, half lines.

f8_room_nbp_t1.subject: F8 ROOM
f8_room_nbp_t1.issues: Properly mischievous smirk-wink with pearl/orange two-tone light, but heavier gradient shading and a sharper, older face than the sheet.

f8_room_gpt_t1.subject: F8 ROOM
f8_room_gpt_t1.issues: Closest to the sheet's face and flat cel style; but the sleeve patch is garbled glyphs, the wink is sweet rather than mischievous, no monitor light on the face.

f8_room_gpt_e1_t1.subject: F8 ROOM
f8_room_gpt_e1_t1.issues: gpt-image-2 edit: sleeve patch reads '1420 MHz', sly one-sided smile with arched brow, pearl monitor key light on the left of her face and hair; flat cel shading, crisp lines, brown eyes, light-blue chest circle and orange headphones per the sheet, no yellow cast. Minor: the orange lamp rim on the hair is weak; she winks with her right eye (renderer redraws the eyelid anyway).

f5_marble_nbp_e2_t1.subject: F5 MARBLE
f5_marble_nbp_e2_t1.issues: Edit: Thales swapped for the canonical design (thales2_e1); side effect: the marble Mede's battle cry became a grin.

f5_marble_nbp_e2p_t1.subject: F5 MARBLE
f5_marble_nbp_e2p_t1.issues: Local composite: f5_marble_nbp_e2 with the marble Mede's face pasted back from e1. The battle frozen as marble on the red riverbank at night: rearing horse, crested Lydian in a carved scale corselet, Mede in a cap with a wicker shield, arrows hanging in the air, a flock stopped mid-flight, spray frozen like glass, blank stone eyes; black sun with a pearl corona, one Jupiter, orange 360-degree horizon glow, umber sky with no blue; canonical Thales (about 40, knotted hair, fillet, chin beard) in living colour looking up with a knowing half-smile. Minor: statues are lit flat rather than raking from the corona and horizon; Thales stands rather than walks; Jupiter is left more than above (style frame, not astronomy); the illustration is digital-painting rather than painterly.
